user.title: Set up Filmtracker
user.description:
You need a free **TMDb API key (v3)**: [themoviedb.org → Settings → API](https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api).

AI and Trakt are optional and can be changed later under **Configure**.

data_description.tmdb_key: Required – used for search, posters, episodes and streaming providers.
data_description.ki_primary: An AI task entity (e.g. Ollama, OpenAI, Google) for recommendations.
data_description.ki_fallback: Used when the primary AI does not respond.
data_description.trakt_client_id: Optional. Create an app at trakt.tv/oauth/applications/new, redirect URI: urn:ietf:wg:oauth:2.0:oob

error.invalid_auth: The TMDb API key is invalid.
error.trakt_incomplete: For Trakt enter both client ID and client secret (or leave both empty).

init.title: Filmtracker settings
init.description:
TMDb key: {tmdb} · Trakt: {trakt}

Leave key and secret fields empty to keep the stored values.

data_description.tmdb_key: Only fill in to change the key.
data_description.ki_fallback: Used when the primary AI does not respond.
data_description.check_time: Daily check for new episodes and new availability on subscriptions.
data_description.trakt_client_id: Clear to disable Trakt. App: trakt.tv/oauth/applications/new, redirect URI: urn:ietf:wg:oauth:2.0:oob
data_description.trakt_client_secret: Only fill in on first setup or to change it.

error.invalid_auth: The TMDb API key is invalid.
error.trakt_incomplete: For Trakt enter both client ID and client secret (or clear the client ID).

check_now.name: Check now
check_now.description: Checks everyone's lists for new episodes and new availability on their subscriptions and sends push notifications.
